record.bible_text: And Solomon<WH08010> determined<WH0559><WTH8799> to build<WH01129><WTH8800> an house<WH01004> for the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068>, and an house<WH01004> for his kingdom<WH04438>.

And Solomon<WH08010> told out<WH05608><WTH8799> threescore and ten<WH07657> thousand<WH0505> men<WH0376> to bear burdens<WH05449>, and fourscore<WH08084> thousand<WH0505><WH0376> to hew<WH02672><WTH8802> in the mountain<WH02022>, and three<WH07969> thousand<WH0505> and six<WH08337> hundred<WH03967> to oversee<WH05329><WTH8764> them.

And Solomon<WH08010> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> to Huram<WH02361> the king<WH04428> of Tyre<WH06865>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, As thou didst deal<WH06213><WTH8804> with David<WH01732> my father<WH01>, and didst send<WH07971><WTH8799> him cedars<WH0730> to build<WH01129><WTH8800> him an house<WH01004> to dwell<WH03427><WTH8800> therein, <FI>even so deal with me<Fi> . <RF>Huram: or, Hiram<Rf>

Behold, I build<WH01129><WTH8802> an house<WH01004> to the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>, to dedicate<WH06942><WTH8687> <FI>it<Fi> to him, <FI>and<Fi> to burn<WH06999><WTH8687> before<WH06440> him sweet<WH05561> incense<WH07004>, and for the continual<WH08548> shewbread<WH04635>, and for the burnt offerings<WH05930> morning<WH01242> and evening<WH06153>, on the sabbaths<WH07676>, and on the new moons<WH02320>, and on the solemn feasts<WH04150> of the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430>. This <FI>is an ordinance<Fi> for ever<WH05769> to Israel<WH03478>. <RF>sweet...: Heb. incense of spices<Rf>
And the house<WH01004> which I build<WH01129><WTH8802> <FI>is<Fi> great<WH01419>: for great<WH01419> <FI>is<Fi> our God<WH0430> above all gods<WH0430>.

But who is able<WH06113><WTH8799><WH03581> to build<WH01129><WTH8800> him an house<WH01004>, seeing the heaven<WH08064> and heaven<WH08064> of heavens<WH08064> cannot contain<WH03557><WTH8770> him? who <FI>am<Fi> I then, that I should build<WH01129><WTH8799> him an house<WH01004>, save only<WH0518> to burn sacrifice<WH06999><WTH8687> before<WH06440> him? <RF>is able: Heb. hath retained, or, obtained strength<Rf>

Send<WH07971><WTH8798> me now therefore a man<WH0376> cunning<WH02450> to work<WH06213><WTH8800> in gold<WH02091>, and in silver<WH03701>, and in brass<WH05178>, and in iron<WH01270>, and in purple<WH0710>, and crimson<WH03758>, and blue<WH08504>, and that can skill<WH03045><WTH8802> to grave<WH06605><WTH8763><WH06603> with the cunning men<WH02450> that <FI>are<Fi> with me in Judah<WH03063> and in Jerusalem<WH03389>, whom David<WH01732> my father<WH01> did provide<WH03559><WTH8689>. <RF>to grave: Heb. to grave gravings<Rf>

Send<WH07971><WTH8798> me also cedar<WH0730> trees<WH06086>, fir trees<WH01265>, and algum trees<WH0418>, out of Lebanon<WH03844>: for I know<WH03045><WTH8804> that thy servants<WH05650> can skill<WH03045><WTH8802> to cut<WH03772><WTH8800> timber<WH06086> in Lebanon<WH03844>; and, behold, my servants<WH05650> <FI>shall be<Fi> with thy servants<WH05650>, <RF>algum: also called, almuggim<Rf>

Even to prepare<WH03559><WTH8687> me timber<WH06086> in abundance<WH07230>: for the house<WH01004> which I am about to build<WH01129><WTH8802> <FI>shall be<Fi> wonderful<WH06381><WTH8687> great<WH01419>. <RF>wonderful...: Heb. great and wonderful<Rf>

And, behold, I will give<WH05414><WTH8804> to thy servants<WH05650>, the hewers<WH02404><WTH8802> that cut<WH03772><WTH8802> timber<WH06086>, twenty<WH06242> thousand<WH0505> measures<WH03734> of beaten<WH04347> wheat<WH02406>, and twenty<WH06242> thousand<WH0505> measures<WH03734> of barley<WH08184>, and twenty<WH06242> thousand<WH0505> baths<WH01324> of wine<WH03196>, and twenty<WH06242> thousand<WH0505> baths<WH01324> of oil<WH08081>.<CM>

Then Huram<WH02361> the king<WH04428> of Tyre<WH06865> answered<WH0559><WTH8799> in writing<WH03791>, which he sent<WH07971><WTH8799> to Solomon<WH08010>, Because the LORD<WH03068> hath loved<WH0160> his people<WH05971>, he hath made<WH05414><WTH8804> thee king<WH04428> over them.

Huram<WH02361> said<WH0559><WTH8799> moreover, Blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, that made<WH06213><WTH8804> heaven<WH08064> and earth<WH0776>, who hath given<WH05414><WTH8804> to David<WH01732> the king<WH04428> a wise<WH02450> son<WH01121>, endued<WH03045><WTH8802> with prudence<WH07922> and understanding<WH0998>, that might build<WH01129><WTH8799> an house<WH01004> for the LORD<WH03068>, and an house<WH01004> for his kingdom<WH04438>. <RF>endued...: Heb. knowing prudence and understanding<Rf>
And now I have sent<WH07971><WTH8804> a cunning<WH02450> man<WH0376>, endued<WH03045><WTH8802> with understanding<WH0998>, of Huram<WH02361> my father's<WH01>,

The son<WH01121> of a woman<WH0802> of the daughters<WH01323> of Dan<WH01835>, and his father<WH01> <FI>was<Fi> a man<WH0376> of Tyre<WH06876>, skilful<WH03045><WTH8802> to work<WH06213><WTH8800> in gold<WH02091>, and in silver<WH03701>, in brass<WH05178>, in iron<WH01270>, in stone<WH068>, and in timber<WH06086>, in purple<WH0713>, in blue<WH08504>, and in fine linen<WH0948>, and in crimson<WH03758>; also to grave<WH06605><WTH8763> any manner of graving<WH06603>, and to find out<WH02803><WTH8800> every device<WH04284> which shall be put<WH05414><WTH8735> to him, with thy cunning men<WH02450>, and with the cunning men<WH02450> of my lord<WH0113> David<WH01732> thy father<WH01>.

Now therefore the wheat<WH02406>, and the barley<WH08184>, the oil<WH08081>, and the wine<WH03196>, which my lord<WH0113> hath spoken<WH0559><WTH8804> of, let him send<WH07971><WTH8799> unto his servants<WH05650>:

And we will cut<WH03772><WTH8799> wood<WH06086> out of Lebanon<WH03844>, as much as thou shalt need<WH06878>: and we will bring<WH0935><WTH8686> it to thee in floats<WH07513> by sea<WH03220> to Joppa<WH03305>; and thou shalt carry it up<WH05927><WTH8686> to Jerusalem<WH03389>. <RF>as much...: Heb according to all thy need<Rf> <RF>Joppa: Heb. Japho<Rf>

And Solomon<WH08010> numbered<WH05608><WTH8799> all the strangers<WH0582><WH01616> that <FI>were<Fi> in the land<WH0776> of Israel<WH03478>, after<WH0310> the numbering<WH05610> wherewith David<WH01732> his father<WH01> had numbered<WH05608><WTH8804> them; and they were found<WH04672><WTH8735> an hundred<WH03967> and fifty<WH02572> thousand<WH0505> and three<WH07969> thousand<WH0505> and six<WH08337> hundred<WH03967>. <RF>the strangers: Heb. the men the strangers<Rf>

And he set<WH06213><WTH8799> threescore and ten<WH07657> thousand<WH0505> of them <FI>to be<Fi> bearers of burdens<WH05449>, and fourscore<WH08084> thousand<WH0505> <FI>to be<Fi> hewers<WH02672><WTH8802> in the mountain<WH02022>, and three<WH07969> thousand<WH0505> and six<WH08337> hundred<WH03967> overseers<WH05329><WTH8764> to set<WH05647><WH00> the people<WH05971> a work<WH05647><WTH8687>.<CM>
